correctness.rationale: The eigenprojectors P0,Pn,P_j resolve the multipartite Laplacian into three entry classes. Even Taylor truncations are strictly convex and positive; only cross-part entries impose beta_p/n. Odd truncations are strictly decreasing, and the Jensen gap divided by x^2 is strictly decreasing; diagonals and within-part entries have unique terminal zeros. The cubic Jensen identity yields the minimum-size/singleton law. Independent polynomial matrix multiplication agreed on six partitions, five degrees and four normalized steps. The all-order result rests on the proof.
residual_risks: The claims are final-step entrywise nonnegativity only, not stagewise SSP positivity.
